name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: defending religious freedom and security
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is passing a statement that strongly condemns attacks on Christians in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo by armed groups, especially the Allied Democratic Forces. It calls for an immediate ceasefire, for Rwanda to withdraw its troops, for those responsible to face justice, and for more humanitarian aid and sanctions. It is an opinion, not a legal change.

- **What changes:** Nothing in law. Parliament states its position and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** Christians and other civilians in eastern Congo, Rwanda, and armed groups there.
- **What happens next:** The statement goes to the EU Council, Commission and others. They decide whether to act.
